card.name: Linking words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words (OR, AND, NOT, TO, MAY, CAN) and the end of UTERINE inside warning text written entirely in capital letters.

modes.label: Linking words in caps
modes.description: A short connector such as OR, AND, NOT, MAY or CAN in an all-caps warning sentence.
modes.example: IF PREGNANT OR IF PAIN PERSISTS<< OR>> WORSENS.

modes.label: Inside a caps medical word
modes.description: The ending of a medical adjective in a capitalized warning.
modes.example: WITH PRIOR UTER<<INE>> SURGERY, INCLUDING CESAREAN
